source_documents.title: Aggregation-induced emission (AIE) behavior and thermochromic luminescence properties of a new gold(I) complex

reference_evidence_units.quote: an emission band was observed with lmax at 402 nm and 425 nm
reference_evidence_units.subject: gold(I) complex 1
reference_evidence_units.conditions: EtOH/water at approximately 20 micromolar, excitation 310 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Water addition first enhances blue emission; higher water fractions decrease blue emission and produce a 559 nm band.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The response is nonmonotonic, with further water eventually weakening the yellow-green emission.

reference_evidence_units.quote: We speculate that two kinds of nano-aggregates might be formed
reference_evidence_units.subject: gold(I) complex 1
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Water-fraction-dependent spectra and main-text description of DLS in SI.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors propose different aggregates and packing-dependent Au-Au interactions as the cause of color changes.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The authors' speculative wording is retained; DLS does not resolve Au-Au distances in the emitting aggregates.

reference_evidence_units.quote: a broad emission band, with a maximum wavelength of 530 nm
reference_evidence_units.subject: gold(I) complex 1 solid
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Heating above approximately 55 degrees C, then cooling to 25 degrees C, Fig. 2.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The blue solid develops a broad 530 nm band on heating and recovers the original emission after cooling.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Thermochromism is observed; a particular amorphous packing geometry is not directly established by this observation.

reference_evidence_units.subject: gold(I) complex 1 solid
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Interpretation of thermally induced lower-energy emission.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Aurophilic interactions and an LMMCT state are proposed for the yellow-green emission.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This metal-associated assignment does not itself establish a measured triplet lifetime or phosphorescence.

reference_evidence_units.quote: no obvious intermolecular gold–gold interaction is indicated.
reference_evidence_units.subject: gold(I) complex 1 initial crystal
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Reported X-ray packing, Fig. 3; initial crystal before thermal transformation.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The initial crystal has Au-Au separations reported as 3.782 and 4.83 angstrom, too long for the strong aurophilic contacts proposed for the emitting transformed material.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not claim the initial crystal directly proves the short Au-Au contact of the heated or aggregated phase; graph identity is not adjudicated here.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Cooling then made the amorphous phase rearrange into the more stable crystalline phase.
reference_evidence_units.subject: gold(I) complex 1
reference_evidence_units.statement: The paper interprets recovery as a packing/phase rearrangement after cooling.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: A bounded phase explanation; obtain SI or additional phase characterization before treating all phase assignments as independently verified.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Changes in assembly and solid-state packing are central to the source explanation; specific transformed geometries are inferred.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The broad family covers the proposed aurophilic metal-associated LMMCT state. Do not equate this with independently measured triplet dynamics.
